from pathlib import Path
import importlib,hashlib
m=importlib.import_module('strsimpy.weighted_levenshtein')

from strsimpy.weighted_levenshtein import WeightedLevenshtein
metric=WeightedLevenshtein(substitution_cost_fn=lambda a,b:4,insertion_cost_fn=lambda c:2,deletion_cost_fn=lambda c:3)
r=metric.distance('ab','ac');print('weighted_distance',r)
assert r==4
